$comment: Central registry of all individual speech recordings across the Sauti Labs platform. Each entry must conform to frameworks/speech-registry/schema/speech-recording.schema.json. Each entry references a source_id (this framework) and optionally a speaker_id (speaker-registry). Per ADR-0002, recordings linked to a speaker with unresolved or withdrawn consent must not be used to derive a dataset.

recordings.notes: Sentence: Vyombo vya kupikia pilau la viazi. Self-reported demographics (per Common Voice metadata, NOT a speaker-registry entry since contributor is anonymous): age twenties, gender male_masculine, accent Kiswahili Sanifu (EA). Real duration sourced from Common Voice own clip_durations.tsv, not estimated.
